title: Chapter 267 Calling
content:
Chapter 267 Calling

Although he was surprised that the emperor of Yuguo was thirty years old and hadn't been close to a woman yet.

But what really caught his attention was Chen Lin's last sentence, accepting the daughter of the Korean clan as the imperial concubine.

This is not a casual talk, if it is true, then South Korea and Yuguo are in a marriage relationship, the relationship between the two parties will be closer, and the exchanges with each other will be more frequent.

The most important thing is that South Korea will have a solid backer, and there is no need to worry about the crisis of South Korea being destroyed by other countries at any time.

After all, with the most powerful country in the world, backed by the Hezong Changyu Kingdom of the Six Kingdoms, who would dare to touch his relative South Korea?

Thinking of this, Han Wang did not show a smile, and looked at Chen Lin with very friendly eyes.

"The lord of your country is willing to accept a member of my Korean clan as a concubine. This king naturally agrees, but I don't know who is so blessed to be in the eyes of your lord!"

For this chosen daughter of the Korean clan, not only the king of Han cares about it, but everyone in Korea cares about it.

They understand that this woman who ascended to heaven in one step will maintain the relationship between South Korea and Yuguo in the future. Her responsibilities and rights are important, which can be said to be second only to King Han's influence on South Korea.

With all these concerns, King Han was naturally very curious about this so-called daughter of the clan.

"Your Highness, this woman is none other than His Highness's daughter, Princess Honglian!" Chen Lin's words excited and surprised King Han.

It turned out to be my own daughter, that's great.

King Han couldn't help but think so.

He had some concerns before, fearing that the chosen daughter of the clan would be someone else, if his heart was for South Korea, for the King of Han, that would be fine.

But if this woman harbored resentment towards South Korea and the King of Han, and made some small moves in secret, the blow to South Korea would be fatal.

This kind of worry had already appeared in King Han's heart when Chen Lin proposed to win the daughter of the Korean clan.

The royal family is the most ruthless. Everything here is about profit and power. Under such an environment, it is bound to be difficult to guarantee that everyone will love King Han. There are always some losers or ambitious people waiting for opportunities.

Now, this opportunity presents itself.

Fortunately, it was King Han's daughter, Honglian, his only princess, who got this opportunity.

"It turned out to be my princess, what a coincidence! Since my princess has such a fate, I naturally agree!" King Han nodded happily. He naturally agreed with such a marriage.

"Since that's the case, I wonder if His Highness can invite the princess to come out to see her. It's a matter of marriage, so we need to ask for the opinions of the parties involved?" Chen Lin's face became even more smiling.

"Princess please come out?" King Han hesitated.

In today's world, what is important is the order of the parents and the words of the matchmaker.

In other words, as long as Han Wang made up his mind and wanted to marry off his daughter, as long as he made an agreement with the man, then those sons and daughters would not be allowed to refuse.

Now this Chen Lin, the envoy of Yuguo, actually asked to see his princess, the future imperial concubine of Yuguo, which made King Han feel hesitant.

South Korea is a country that pays attention to etiquette. His etiquette has penetrated into every part of South Korea. He is always a little bit stubborn about such unethical things.

"Your Highness, before the foreign ministers went on a mission, His Majesty the Emperor of our country specifically explained that marriage is a life-long event for two people, so we must be cautious. Therefore, although His Majesty loves the princess of your country, he must respect the will of the princess of your country and ask her Is it suitable?" When Chen Lin said this, although her tone was still serious, her lips curled up in her heart, a little disdainful.

Chen Lin is also a person who is deeply bound by etiquette. He was taught by etiquette since he was a child that marriage has always been a matter between parents and elders, and has nothing to do with the younger generations of those involved.

Now, His Majesty the Emperor, although he has been well-mannered and military-strength in other aspects, he has made great achievements in battle. But there is no doubt that there is still some personal love in this respect.

However, out of the responsibility of the envoy and the execution of the emperor's order, he still spoke out seriously and made this request.

"Oh, it turned out to be your lord's request. Since this is the case, the lonely king will naturally not refuse!" Han Wang was stunned for a moment, apparently not expecting such a reason. But he reacted quickly and quickly agreed.

However, he was even more disdainful in his heart.

I heard from Chen Lin before that the lord of a country has been obsessed with cultivating longevity for an unknown number of years. He has abandoned all state affairs and delegated power to ministers. This is the cause of the country's disasters and turmoil.

No wonder it was King Jing who led the army to go to war before. It must be quite a headache for a country to have such an emperor!

Thinking of such a layer, King Han was a little worried.

From this point of view, it seems that the situation in this imperial country is not very good now, and there are great hidden dangers inside.

The ruler of the country gave up his power and let his younger brother take charge of the country. The domestic ministers don't know what happened, and there are serious internal disputes.

Then if at this time, marrying the princess to the emperor of the imperial kingdom, would it cause disaster? Not good for Korea.

King Han didn't care about his princess. To him, Honglian was just a daughter. Compared with the throne, the weight couldn't be lighter.

In the original book, he ordered the princess to be married to Ji Wuye, an ambitious old man who was nearly half a century old. Nowadays, people who marry a princess to the emperor of a country, which is still the most powerful country in the world, and who are under 30 years old, of course don't care, and think that their daughter is taking advantage of it.

What King Han is afraid of is that it seems that the emperor Yuguo has no right now, and he doesn't know when there will be turmoil in Yuguo. If the emperor loses power, will the victor's side point the finger at South Korea, which is married to the emperor?

King Han couldn't help feeling extremely worried.

Han Wang's worries had not dissipated, but his thoughts were interrupted by a voice below.

"Since that's the case, please call the princess to see her and ask her opinion face to face!" Chen Lin's sincere and serious words clearly reached King Han's ears.

This voice was like enlightenment, and it immediately cleared his mind a lot.

Yes, why think so much now? It's not certain that there will be civil strife in the Royal Parliament!

What's more, even if civil strife really happened, would he really give up his foreign aid because of a princess?

The situation in today's world is so complicated, it is always good to have one more ally.

Thinking of this, King Han couldn't help showing more smiles gradually.

"Since the envoy is so eager, then the lonely king is not hypocritical. Come, hurry up and summon Princess Honglian, and declare him to come to Chengde Palace to have an audience!"

King Han's loud voice came from above the main hall, and soon there was a guard at the entrance of the hall. After hearing the order, he quickly retreated and walked towards the palace of Princess Honglian in the harem!

After writing it, I found that I was really not good at writing emotional dramas.
